# Dikciz Launcher documentation

> Programmable Android launcher and HTML/CSS/JavaScript app runtime with Lua and headless JavaScript backends, AI chat, and shared MCP, HTTP and WebSocket phone APIs.

Discover schemas from the installed APK before invoking a command. Android permissions, scoped remote grants and chat read-only enforcement are separate boundaries. Accepted work does not prove an external effect completed.
